newsitem.title: USA: ABC News, Discovery Channel to start news.
newsitem.headline: ABC News, Discovery Channel to start news.

text.p: ABC News and Discovery Channel said they are are planning to join forces to cover science news.
The two companies were expected to announce the venture, called "Discovery News," at a news conference tentatively scheduled for Thursday.
Discovery News is to premiere on the Discovery Channel on April 4, the two companies said.
Neither company would comment further on the deal. A spokeswoman for ABC also said it was possible that the news conference would not take place Thursday as originally planned.
ABC is a unit of Walt Disney Co. Discovery Channel is owned by Discovery Communications Inc, a unit of Liberty Media Corp.
Last year, General Electric Co's NBC television network and National Geographic said they would launch a new cable television channel in 1997.
